DELETE FROM schedules s USING deployment_profiles p
WHERE s.profile_id=p.id AND p.name='account-auto' AND p.version=1 AND s.last_run_at IS NULL;

INSERT INTO schedules(id,account_id,profile_id,enabled,interval_seconds,batch_size,max_concurrent,next_run_at)
SELECT gen_random_uuid(),a.id,p.id,true,a.auto_interval_seconds,a.auto_batch_size,a.auto_max_concurrent,
       now()+make_interval(secs=>a.auto_interval_seconds)
FROM accounts a
JOIN deployment_profiles p ON p.account_id=a.id AND p.name='account-auto' AND p.version=1
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedules s WHERE s.account_id=a.id AND s.profile_id=p.id);

ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS desired_server_count;

ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS desired_server_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD CONSTRAINT accounts_desired_server_count_check CHECK (desired_server_count BETWEEN 0 AND 1000);

WHERE data->'Droplets' IS NULL OR data->'Droplets' = 'null'::jsonb;

ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS fallback_any_region;
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fallback_any_region BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS droplets_replacement_deployment_uidx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS droplets_live_provider_uidx;

-- At most one live lifecycle row may own a provider droplet per account.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS droplets_live_provider_uidx
ON droplets(account_id,provider_resource_id)
WHERE provider_resource_id IS NOT NULL AND state <> 'DELETED';

-- At most one replacement may be in flight for one expiring droplet.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS droplets_replacement_deployment_uidx
ON droplets(replacement_deployment_id)
WHERE replacement_deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND state <> 'DELETED';
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS account_capacity_events;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account_capacity_events (
 id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 account_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 old_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,
 new_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,
 delta INTEGER NOT NULL,
 detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 snapshot_id UUID REFERENCES provider_snapshots(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS account_capacity_events_account_time_idx ON account_capacity_events(account_id,detected_at DESC);
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS resources_provider_identity_uidx;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS resources_provider_identity_uidx ON resources(account_id,provider,type,provider_resource_id);
REVOKE SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON TABLE account_capacity_events FROM digitaloceanbot;
GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON TABLE account_capacity_events TO digitaloceanbot;

ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS next_build_at;

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS password_rotation_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'disabled',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS password_rotated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
